root_cause.summary: LinkedIn exact-provider reconciliation was nested inside the Buffer-health branch, so an open Buffer 429 circuit suppressed reconciliation of Composio-owned LinkedIn post URNs even though Buffer is not the LinkedIn transport.
root_cause.cause: provider reconciliation orchestration coupled unrelated providers

prevention_rules: Always run exact LinkedIn Composio reconciliation independently of Buffer state.
Pass a null Buffer token when Buffer audit is unavailable and skip only Buffer-owned records.
Never clear LinkedIn reconciliation results because Buffer containment receives 429.
Preserve exact LinkedIn URNs and keep republish forbidden until the same URN is reconciled.

evidence.runtime_observation: Buffer circuit was open until 2026-09-29 while LinkedIn daily claims already had provider URNs.

outcome.intended_state: Buffer cooldown affects only Buffer-owned audit/containment; LinkedIn personal/company reconciliation stays available every run.
